notice: Calibration scenarios, not a claim of balanced or guaranteed outcomes. Ordinary tyre, fuel, pit and driving rules; dry weather; calm (low-incident) mode.

scenarios.title: Two routes to the finish
scenarios.objective: Bring both cars home; compare an earlier stop with a longer first stint.
scenarios.hint: The starting plans are approved, not forced. Read the rejoin estimate before either window opens; change or clear the plan explicitly.

scenarios.title: Two cars, one box
scenarios.objective: Complete both races while managing shared-box exposure.
scenarios.hint: Both approved windows overlap on purpose. Stagger a window, split plans, or accept a physical queue. Priority cannot teleport cars.

scenarios.title: Protect track position
scenarios.objective: Bring both cars home and compare a legal no-stop with a tyre offset.
scenarios.hint: The no-stop car begins on hard tyres. The other car has an approved stop. The geometry and actual race, not the scenario text, determine which works.

scenarios.title: Fresh tyres, little time
scenarios.objective: Bring both cars home; decide whether the late stop can repay its full loss.
scenarios.hint: A late stop is deliberately proposed for MOR. It is not guaranteed to be worthwhile. Compare with a no-stop draft and approve the approach you prefer.
